fn rt_semantics<'l>(env: &mut JNIEnv<'l>) -> blazon_rt::Result<StarlarkSemantics<'l>> {
    StarlarkSemantics::default_semantics(env)
}
#[derive(
    starlark::values::ProvidesStaticType,
    starlark::values::NoSerialize,
    allocative::Allocative
)]
pub struct WidgetValue {
    #[allocative(skip)]
    pub obj: blazon_rt::Global<Widget<'static>>,
}
starlark::starlark_simple_value!(WidgetValue);
impl WidgetValue {
    pub fn new(obj: &jni::objects::JObject) -> blazon_rt::Result<Self> {
        let env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
        Ok(WidgetValue {
            obj: blazon_rt::Global::new(env.new_global_ref(obj)?),
        })
    }
    fn text(&self) -> blazon_rt::Result<String> {
        let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
        let obj = self.obj.get(&mut env)?;
        let sem = rt_semantics(&mut env)?;
        Starlark::str(&mut env, &obj, &sem)
    }
    fn repr_text(&self) -> blazon_rt::Result<String> {
        let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
        let obj = self.obj.get(&mut env)?;
        Starlark::repr(&mut env, &obj)
    }
}
impl<'a, K: blazon_rt::Rebind<'a>, V: blazon_rt::Rebind<'a>> Widget<'a, K, V> {
    /// This object as a Starlark value.
    pub fn to_value<'v>(
        &self,
        heap: starlark::values::Heap<'v>,
    ) -> blazon_rt::Result<starlark::values::Value<'v>> {
        let env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
        Ok(
            heap
                .alloc(WidgetValue {
                    obj: blazon_rt::Global::new(env.new_global_ref(&self.obj)?),
                }),
        )
    }
}
impl blazon_starlark::JavaValue for WidgetValue {
    fn java_object(&self) -> blazon_rt::Result<jni::objects::JObject<'static>> {
        let env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
        Ok(
            env
                .new_local_ref(unsafe {
                    jni::objects::JObject::from_raw(self.obj.raw())
                })?,
        )
    }
}
impl std::fmt::Display for WidgetValue {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self.text() {
            Ok(s) => f.write_str(&s),
            Err(e) => write!(f, concat!("<", "widget", ": {}>"), e),
        }
    }
}

        f.write_str(stringify!(WidgetValue))
    }
}
#[starlark::values::starlark_value(type = "widget")]
impl<'v> starlark::values::StarlarkValue<'v> for WidgetValue {
    fn get_methods() -> Option<&'static starlark::environment::Methods> {
        static RES: starlark::environment::MethodsStatic = starlark::environment::MethodsStatic::new(
            "widget_methods",
            widget_methods,
        );
        Some(RES.methods())
    }
    fn collect_repr(&self, collector: &mut String) {
        match self.repr_text() {
            Ok(s) => collector.push_str(&s),
            Err(e) => collector.push_str(&format!(concat!("<", "widget", ": {}>"), e)),
        }
    }
    fn to_bool(&self) -> bool {
        (|| -> blazon_rt::Result<bool> {
            let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
            let obj = self.obj.get(&mut env)?;
            Starlark::truth(&mut env, &obj)
        })()
            .unwrap_or(true)
    }
    fn at(
        &self,
        index: starlark::values::Value<'v>,
        heap: starlark::values::Heap<'v>,
    ) -> starlark::Result<starlark::values::Value<'v>> {
        (|| -> blazon_rt::Result<starlark::values::Value<'v>> {
            let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
            let sem = rt_semantics(&mut env)?;
            let key = Object::of(index.to_java()?);
            let ix: StarlarkIndexable = self.obj.get(&mut env)?.downcast()?;
            let r = ix.get_index(&sem, &key)?;
            blazon_starlark::wrap(r.as_ref(), heap)
        })()
            .map_err(blazon_starlark::error)
    }
    fn is_in(&self, other: starlark::values::Value<'v>) -> starlark::Result<bool> {
        (|| -> blazon_rt::Result<bool> {
            let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
            let sem = rt_semantics(&mut env)?;
            let key = Object::of(other.to_java()?);
            let t: StarlarkMembershipTestable = self.obj.get(&mut env)?.downcast()?;
            t.contains_key(&sem, &key)
        })()
            .map_err(blazon_starlark::error)
    }
    fn equals(&self, other: starlark::values::Value<'v>) -> starlark::Result<bool> {
        match other.downcast_ref::<WidgetValue>() {
            Some(o) => {
                (|| -> blazon_rt::Result<bool> {
                    let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
                    Ok(self.obj.get(&mut env)? == o.obj.get(&mut env)?)
                })()
                    .map_err(blazon_starlark::error)
            }
            None => Ok(false),
        }
    }
    fn write_hash(
        &self,
        hasher: &mut starlark::collections::StarlarkHasher,
    ) -> starlark::Result<()> {
        let h = (|| -> blazon_rt::Result<i32> {
            let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
            blazon_rt::java::lang::hash_code(self.obj.get(&mut env)?.as_ref())
        })()
            .map_err(blazon_starlark::error)?;
        hasher.write_i32(h);
        Ok(())
    }
}
#[starlark::starlark_module]
fn widget_methods(builder: &mut starlark::environment::MethodsBuilder) {
    /// Scales by factor.
    fn scaled<'v>(
        this: &WidgetValue,
        #[starlark(require = pos)]
        factor: Option<blazon_starlark::Either<i32, &'v str>>,
        #[starlark(require = named)]
        tag: Option<starlark::values::Value<'v>>,
        heap: starlark::values::Heap<'v>,
    ) -> starlark::Result<starlark::values::Value<'v>> {
        (|| -> blazon_rt::Result<starlark::values::Value<'v>> {
            let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
            let __obj = this.obj.get(&mut env)?;
            let __p0 = match &factor {
                Some(a) => Object::of(blazon_starlark::ToJava::to_java(a)?),
                None => Object::of(blazon_starlark::ToJava::to_java(&1i64)?),
            };
            let __p1 = match &tag {
                Some(a) => Object::of(blazon_starlark::ToJava::to_java(a)?),
                None => Object::of(Starlark::none(&mut env)?.into_raw()),
            };
            let __r = __obj.scaled(&__p0, &__p1)?;
            Ok(
                match __r {
                    Some(x) => heap.alloc(x),
                    None => starlark::values::Value::new_none(),
                },
            )
        })()
            .map_err(blazon_starlark::error)
    }
    /// The size.
    #[starlark(attribute)]
    fn size<'v>(
        this: &WidgetValue,
        _heap: starlark::values::Heap<'v>,
    ) -> starlark::Result<i32> {
        (|| -> blazon_rt::Result<i32> {
            let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
            let __obj = this.obj.get(&mut env)?;
            let __r = __obj.size()?;
            Ok(__r)
        })()
            .map_err(blazon_starlark::error)
    }
}

/// The generated Starlark types of this version.
pub struct Bridge;
impl blazon_starlark::Registry for Bridge {
    fn wrap<'v>(
        &self,
        obj: &jni::objects::JObject,
        heap: starlark::values::Heap<'v>,
    ) -> blazon_rt::Result<Option<starlark::values::Value<'v>>> {
        let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
        {
            static CLASS: blazon_rt::member::ClassRef = blazon_rt::member::ClassRef::new(
                "fx/Widget",
            );
            if CLASS.is_instance(&mut env, obj)? {
                return Ok(Some(heap.alloc(WidgetValue::new(obj)?)));
            }
        }
        {
            static CLASS: blazon_rt::member::ClassRef = blazon_rt::member::ClassRef::new(
                "fx/Base",
            );
            if CLASS.is_instance(&mut env, obj)? {
                return Ok(Some(heap.alloc(BaseValue::new(obj)?)));
            }
        }
        {
            static CLASS: blazon_rt::member::ClassRef = blazon_rt::member::ClassRef::new(
                "fx/Prims",
            );
            if CLASS.is_instance(&mut env, obj)? {
                return Ok(Some(heap.alloc(PrimsValue::new(obj)?)));
            }
        }
        {
            static CLASS: blazon_rt::member::ClassRef = blazon_rt::member::ClassRef::new(
                "fx/Widget$Inner",
            );
            if CLASS.is_instance(&mut env, obj)? {
                return Ok(Some(heap.alloc(WidgetInnerValue::new(obj)?)));
            }
        }
        {
            static CLASS: blazon_rt::member::ClassRef = blazon_rt::member::ClassRef::new(
                "net/starlark/java/eval/Starlark",
            );
            if CLASS.is_instance(&mut env, obj)? {
                return Ok(Some(heap.alloc(StarlarkStarlarkValue::new(obj)?)));
            }
        }
        {
            static CLASS: blazon_rt::member::ClassRef = blazon_rt::member::ClassRef::new(
                "net/starlark/java/eval/StarlarkValue",
            );
            if CLASS.is_instance(&mut env, obj)? {
                return Ok(Some(heap.alloc(StarlarkValueValue::new(obj)?)));
            }
        }
        Ok(None)
    }
    fn unwrap(
        &self,
        v: starlark::values::Value,
    ) -> blazon_rt::Result<Option<jni::objects::JObject<'static>>> {
        if let Some(x) = v.downcast_ref::<WidgetValue>() {
            return Ok(Some(x.java_object()?));
        }
        if let Some(x) = v.downcast_ref::<BaseValue>() {
            return Ok(Some(x.java_object()?));
        }
        if let Some(x) = v.downcast_ref::<PrimsValue>() {
            return Ok(Some(x.java_object()?));
        }
        if let Some(x) = v.downcast_ref::<WidgetInnerValue>() {
            return Ok(Some(x.java_object()?));
        }
        if let Some(x) = v.downcast_ref::<StarlarkStarlarkValue>() {
            return Ok(Some(x.java_object()?));
        }
        if let Some(x) = v.downcast_ref::<StarlarkValueValue>() {
            return Ok(Some(x.java_object()?));
        }
        Ok(None)
    }
    fn none(&self) -> blazon_rt::Result<jni::objects::JObject<'static>> {
        let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
        Ok(Starlark::none(&mut env)?.into_raw())
    }
    fn int(&self, v: i64) -> blazon_rt::Result<jni::objects::JObject<'static>> {
        let mut env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
        Ok(StarlarkInt::of(&mut env, v)?.into_raw())
    }
    fn int_value(&self, obj: &jni::objects::JObject) -> blazon_rt::Result<Option<i64>> {
        let env = blazon_rt::vm::env()?;
        let local = env.new_local_ref(obj)?;
        let i: StarlarkInt = Object::of(local).downcast()?;
        Ok(i.to_big_integer()?.to_i64().ok())
    }
}
/// Registers this version's Starlark types with `blazon_starlark`.
pub fn register() {
    blazon_starlark::register(&Bridge);
}
